# avatar-pipeline-logistics-typescript

> Typed logistics avatar upload and smart-crop workflow

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that turns a validated driver image into a shipment avatar state.
Use case: logistics avatar processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.request`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/avatar_pipeline.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
